deliverables: Full-stack open-source payments infrastructure for Cardano
Connections to banking rails, stablecoin systems, and wallet interfaces
Visa card issuance linked directly to onchain balances
Smart contract engineering, account abstraction, batched transactions, settlement logic, and wallet/API ecosystem layer
request.recipient: 2026 Treasury Reserve Smart Contract stake address stake1784sdxt6jjennmstphgdu7l7c2scf5d02a6cve2dgn5s2kq5u3j9v, administered by Intersect for the Wirex project
request.what: Withdraw 3,961,538 ada to fund Bringing Real-World Payments to Cardano with Wirex.

claims.claim: The proposal requests 3,961,538 ada, consisting of 3,846,153 ada for WP1 and 115,385 ada for the Intersect Budget Administration fee.

Wirex proposes to deliver open-source payments infrastructure enabling onchain settlement, banking-rail connections, stablecoin systems, wallet interfaces, and Visa card issuance linked to onchain balances.
The proposer states that Cardano currently lacks seamless rails for everyday spending, merchant acceptance, and fiat-connected financial activity at scale.
Wirex is described as having 7 million users, more than 1.5 million cards issued, more than $20 billion in transaction volume, and experience as a Visa Principal Member.
The proposal achieved the required 67% support threshold during the 2026 Intersect Budget Process Hydra Voting phase.
The requested withdrawal is stated not to breach the 350M ada Net Change Limit covering Epoch 613 to Epoch 713 at the time of submission.
Audit, administrative oversight, reporting obligations, and milestone-based disbursement controls are stated to be included through Intersect and technically capable third parties.
Wirex is stated not to have received ada from the Cardano Treasury within the last 24 months.

Intersect will use Sundae Labs treasury management smart contracts with a Treasury Reserve Smart Contract, one Project-Specific Smart Contract, specified addresses, multisignature permissions, and an external Oversight Committee.
A public dashboard and on-chain records are presented as ways for the community to audit and track the withdrawn ada.

summary: The document requests 3,961,538 ada for a Wirex payments-infrastructure project administered through Intersect, with claimed deliverables around open-source Cardano payment rails, Visa card linkage, wallet/API integrations, smart-contract settlement, and oversight via treasury-management contracts.
